provenance.source: Four user-pasted console files plus requested RUN/SELECTED_PACKAGE/WORKLOADS JSON readback. Local order/median arithmetic and source/manifest/hash checks; not local hardware execution.
provenance.execution_revision_basis: Reported source_lock and manifest hashes exactly match committed Git blobs at33d4971.

audit.P95_and_stage_deltas_scope: Retained as reported by completed audited A5 runner; console prints per-process medians, not individual P95/stage summaries.

selection.reason: All three real corpora improve full Search materially in every paired round, original10M stays near baseline, and split improves the first dense candidate while retaining exact NPU quality/ranking bits. Freeze this candidate for real IndexSDK integration, retaining the small sparse cost explicitly.
selection.measured_tradeoff: Sparse8192 Search median+4.04%/+4.34%, P95+4.35%/+2.93%, equivalent to+1.19/+1.32 microseconds perQ8 batch. A wins2/6 and B1/6 versus baseline. Do not dismiss this as system load or claim zero regression.
selection.additional_limits: Sparse65536 B+1.04% median/+1.80% P95 remains. Synthetic10M B+0.25% remains. No business-wide zero-overhead guarantee or automatic release promotion.

quality_assessment: All three NPU variants have identical TopK score/ID hashes and metrics on300 SciFact,50 TREC-COVID and43 MS MARCO test queries. Original-native BM25S construction strict rankings match project on each Q8 packet, with small FP32 score errors; native tie-policy differences remain separate, strict_equivalent_win is false.
next_phase: No new performance candidate. Integrate frozen source into original IndexSDK host shared library, build and validate public AscendIndexBm25 calls on the same fixed inputs.
